seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Waxhaw, NC: the Christmas Parade, Old Waxhaw Christmas, Santa's Cocoa and Carols, Marvin tree lighting and Hunter Farm Santa.
lede: Waxhaw celebrates Christmas in a small downtown, with a town tree lighting and parade, a museum holiday day and Santa visits at farms and halls nearby.
celebrates: The Town of Waxhaw lights its downtown tree on November 21 and holds its Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 13, with school bands, floats from more than 70 businesses and a special guest from the North Pole. On Saturday, December 12, Museum of the Waxhaws opens Old Waxhaw Christmas free of charge with history, holiday traditions and a vendor market. Nearby, Santa's Cocoa and Carols runs at the American Legion on December 6, the Village of Marvin lights its tree on December 5, and The Hunter Farm in Weddington has Santa at its petting barn and a live nativity.
lastyear: In 2023, Waxhaw Parks and Recreation announced that the Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 10, at 3 pm in Downtown Waxhaw would feature more than 75 festive floats, local businesses and school marching bands. A later parks post called a past parade an unforgettable time, with festive floats and cheerful crowds. We did not find a 2025 recap on a host page we could verify.
facts: The Town of Waxhaw lists a Menorah Lighting on December 9 and a Senior Christmas Party on December 5 on its events calendar alongside the tree lighting and the parade. The Hunter Farm in Weddington calls itself a sixth generation, family owned farm, and its live nativity is in its fourth year. Museum of the Waxhaws also hosts living history days through the year, including a Viking Age day.
trains: Waxhaw does not have a Christmas train ride on our pages. The closest holiday train in our Charlotte guide is THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, which is a long drive from Union County. In Waxhaw itself, the Christmas Parade and the Santa events on this page are the main holiday outings, and Weddington's Hunter Farm offers wagon rides to its petting barn.
train_links: The museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in the Christmas season and is listed in our Charlotte guide.

faq: When is the Waxhaw Christmas Parade in 2026?

The Town of Waxhaw holds its Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 13, 2026, at 3 pm in Downtown Waxhaw. The town's calendar shows it running until 5 pm. The town lists local school marching bands, floats from more than 70 businesses and community members, and a special guest from the North Pole.
Is there a free Christmas event in Waxhaw?

Yes. Old Waxhaw Christmas at Museum of the Waxhaws on Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to 4 pm has free admission, and the Hunter Farm's live nativity in Weddington on December 18 and 19 is free with registration. The Waxhaw Christmas Parade is a public parade with no fee listed.
Where can kids meet Santa near Waxhaw?

Santa's Cocoa and Carols at the American Legion in Waxhaw on December 6 costs $25 for children and $10 for adults. The Village of Marvin tree lighting on December 5 has a Santa appearance, and The Hunter Farm in Weddington has Santa at its petting barn on five days in December.
Was the Waxhaw tree lighting in 2026?

Yes, the Town of Waxhaw lit its downtown tree on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 4 to 6 pm, with the official lighting at 5:45 pm, so that event has passed. The next town events on its calendar are the Menorah Lighting on December 9 and the Christmas Parade on December 13.
Is there a train ride near Waxhaw?

Waxhaw has no train ride on our pages. The N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride and is the nearest holiday train in our Charlotte guide. Check the museum's own site for dates, times and tickets before you plan the trip.
